courses.essentialQuestion: How can evidence strengthen interpretations of AP Government & Politics?

standards.name: Independent Curriculum Design
standards.note: Independent learning resource, not an AP-authorized course.

units.title: Constitutional Principles
units.essentialQuestion: What historical or civic evidence helps us understand constitutional principles?
objectives: Examine key contexts and historical claims.
Analyze evidence and multiple perspectives.
Communicate an evidence-based conclusion.

lessons.title: Founding Ideas
lessons.overview: Planned historical inquiry into Founding Ideas.
objectives: Identify major questions and concepts.
Evaluate sources and perspectives.
Build a supported conclusion.
lessons.inquiryQuestion: What can reliable evidence show us about founding ideas?
lessons.assessmentPlan: Evidence analysis and supported writing.
